title: calyptranthes caryophyllata
intro: Calyptranthes caryophyllata, commonly known as the rose apple, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. The health benefits of Calyptranthes caryophyllata include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
